rationale: Every tight-target run (frac 0.48-0.58) met its target with positive slack, limited by a reg-to-reg path at ss 100C max-RC, so T_eff tracks the target; loose targets are port-limited (~9.9-10.1 ns). The two best (des 8.57, md5 8.81) share cap213 plus post-GRT timing repair and over-delivered ~0.55 ns. Hold (positive, few buffers), DRC (0) and slew/cap (<=101 vs bar 953) leave headroom, so both proposals go to the 0.45 floor (8.49 ns): the des recipe (DELAY 4, no ABC buffering/sizing) and the md5 recipe (AREA 3 with ABC buffering/sizing, which gave ~7 ns reg-to-reg in loose runs, timing-driven placement), with slightly larger resizer setup margins to over-deliver more.
